title: Result manifest
description: Every reported metric must be accompanied by one of these. Missing provenance = invalid.

evidence_class.description: Exactly one. Do not blur categories. For cross-dataset transfer, use the WEAKEST-LINK class (the training/source dataset's class).

source_dataset_class.description: Optional. For cross-dataset transfer: evidence class of the source/training dataset.

target_dataset_class.description: Optional. For cross-dataset transfer: evidence class of the target/test dataset.

level.description: Optional. For cross-dataset transfer: escalation level (e.g. 'naive', 'time_broad', 'time_broad_coral').

use_coral.description: Optional. Whether CORAL domain alignment was applied.

feature_dim.description: Optional. Number of features per sample.

channels.description: Optional. Channel names used for feature extraction.

source_dataset_sha256.description: Optional. For cross-dataset transfer: sha256 of the source dataset.

target_dataset_sha256.description: Optional. For cross-dataset transfer: sha256 of the target dataset.

dataset.description: Dataset/registry id, or 'n/a' for CODE-VERIFIED. For cross-dataset: 'source->target' or source id.

split.description: e.g. leave_one_run_out, cross_dataset, group_shuffle. NOT random row/window split.

dataset_sha256.description: sha256 of the dataset manifest/artifact; 'n/a' only for CODE-VERIFIED

produced_by.description: Path to the script/commit that generated this. Must be an executable, not 'manual'.
